author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬೀಗಿನಡೆಯದಿರೆಂದು ಬಾಗಿದರೆ ಉತ್ತಮವು
ಮಾಗುವುದು ನಡೆನುಡಿಯು ಮನ ಹಿಡಿತವಿರಲು
ಸಾಗುತಿರೆ ಸತ್ಯದಲಿ ವಾಮಮಾರ್ಗವ ತೊರೆದು
ನೀಗುವುದು ಕೊರತೆಗಳ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Rather than strutting, it is better to bow;
conduct ripens when the mind is held in check;
if you walk in truth, leaving the crooked path,
your shortcomings will be overcome, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Humility is better than swagger. A disciplined mind matures our conduct, and walking truthfully, not by crooked ways, overcomes our shortcomings.
